title: Austin Discusses Brown & Root Legal Settlement
summary:
*   City leaders held a special, closed-door meeting to discuss a sensitive legal issue.
*   The primary topic was a settlement offer received from prominent construction companies Brown & Root and Halliburton.
*   This offer related to ongoing litigation, specifically cited as "HUP, et al v. Brown & Root, et al."
*   Any final decisions or votes regarding this settlement were mandated to occur in a future public session.
